description.value: Xin Korean Restaurant is a Korean dining establishment on Bay Street in Victoria, operating Wednesday through Sunday. It occupies a retail building and offers a sit-down restaurant experience for cyclists exploring the city. Korean cuisine typically features hearty, flavourful dishes that would make a satisfying stop mid-tour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record provides name, address (823 Bay Street, Victoria), and opening hours but no phone or email. The website URL points to an Instagram profile, but the fetched content only returned Instagram's generic login and landing pages — no restaurant-specific content was accessible without authentication, so the website is effectively unverifiable. All amenity fields are null as a result; no OSM tags provide amenity detail beyond the restaurant classification itself.
concerns: Website URL points to an Instagram profile that requires login to view; no restaurant-specific content was retrievable, leaving amenities and contact details unverifiable.
No phone number available in OSM or via website.
URL discovery confidence was 'medium' — the Instagram account may not be officially associated with this business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating Korean restaurant in Victoria with OSM-confirmed opening hours and no indicators of closure — a useful stop for touring cyclists.
